O Greatly Merciful God, Infinite Goodnes: Katonda Omusaasizi Ennyo, Obulungi obutaggwaawo, leero abantu bonna bakaaba okuva mu kizikiza ky’obuzibu bwabwe nga basaba ekisa kyo n’okusaasira kwo, Katonda; era bakuba okuva mu ddoboozi lyabwe ery’amaanyi ery’obuzibu. Katonda ow’ekisa, togaana kusaba kw’abagoberezi b’ensi eno! O Mukama, Obulungi obusukka ku kutegeera kwaffe, Oyo amanyi obuzibu bwaffe buli kimu, era amanyi nti mu maanyi gaffe tetusobola kukulinnyaako, tukusaba: tuwe ekisa kyo era weeyongere okwongera ekisa kyo mu ffe, tusobole okukola by’oyagala eby’obutukuvu mu bulamu bwaffe bwonna ne mu kiseera ky’okufa. Leka amaanyi ag’ekisa kyo gatukuume okuva mu mivuyo gy’abalabe b’obulokozi bwaffe, tusobole okubeera n’obwesige ng’abaana bo, okulindirira okujja kwa [Omwana wo] okusembayo, olunaku olumanyiddwa ggwe wekka. Era tusuubira okufuna byonna bye twasuubizibwa Yesu newankubadde obuzibu bwaffe bwonna. Kubanga Yesu ye ssuubi lyaffe: mu mutima gwe ogw’ekisa, nga tuyita mu luggi olugazi, tuyingira mu ggulu (Diary, 1570).

Omutima Ogutukuvu ennyo, Ensibuko y’Ekisa mwe muva ebikadde by’obulungi obutayinza kukkirizika ku bantu bonna, nsaba okufuna omusana gw’okubalabirira. O Yesu, jjukira Okufa kwo okw’obulumi era tokkiriza kufiirwa baamala okununulwa ku bbeeyi ey’omuwendo ogw’Omusaayi gwo ogw’omuwendo ennyo. O Yesu, bwe ndowooza ku bbeeyi ey’amaanyi ey’Omusaayi gwo, nsanyuka olw’obunene bwakyo, kubanga akatono akamu kokka kaali kamala okulokola aboonoonyi bonna. Newankubadde ekibi kye kisibo ky’obubi n’obutakkiriza, omuwendo ogusasuliddwa ku lwaffe tegusobola kugeraageranyizibwa. Noolwekyo, buli muntu akkirize mu Kufa kwa Mukama, era ateekewo essuubi lye mu kisa kye. Katonda tajja kwegaana kisa kye eri muntu yenna. Eggulu n’ensi bisobola okukyuka, naye ekisa kya Katonda tekisobola kuggwaawo. Oh, ssanyu ki ery’amaanyi eriri mu mutima gwange nga ndowooza ku bulungi bwo obutayinza kukkirizika, O Yesu! Njagala okuleeta aboonoonyi bonna ku bigere byo basobole okugulumiza ekisa kyo mu myaka egitaggwaawo (Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska, 72).
